soldier: Soldier head deep brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale brown, pronotum yellowish brown with darker margins, the femora pale yellowish brown, the tibiae and tarsi yellowish brown. The median area of the pronotum has more than 10 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but almost not projecting. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2; the flange over the antennal socket strongly sclerotised, almost reaching the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes yellowish brown, rather close to the antennal socket. Labrum subcircular. Mandibles long, the apices very strongly curved, the outer margin slightly concave; the inner margin of the left mandible with very fine traces of serration. Anterior margin of the pronotum broadly V-shaped, with a U-shaped median concavity, the lateral margins gently sloping backwards, the posterior margin inconspicuously concave.
